finding.class: Partial-span exemption suppresses a required public review match
finding.expected: A compound review term crossing the generated-path boundary requires confirmation, and close without that confirmation has no tag or Release effect.
finding.observed: The fragment fixture closes with status 0, creates the tag and Release, and records null review and confirmation. Pure query and fragment cases return pass.
finding.cause: scripts/lib/outward-lint.mjs:795-813 selects an exempt section using the finding start alone. scripts/release.mjs:2603-2610 intentionally ends generated coverage before the authored query or fragment.
finding.repairRule: Exempt a finding only when its complete matched span is contained within the authorized exemption. Preserve legitimate wholly generated matches, authored review findings, and private redaction.

probeCorrection: The first VER-004 fixture attempt passed an absolute vocabulary path to a helper that expects a relative path. Its configured-term control failed before the release case. The probe now passes the relative path; only the corrected run above establishes F1.
limits: All remote effects observed here belong to temporary synthetic fixture repositories and a local fake forge; no live service was contacted.
The end-to-end failing case uses a fragment. The query variant is established by the pure renderer/linter probe.
The full-span control imports a changed source string in memory; it does not edit or qualify an implementation repair.
No private term disclosure is established by F1; the demonstrated bypass concerns a configured public compound review term.
Earlier follow-ups D018, D019, D025, D026 and D028 remain unchanged; the operator-accepted planning carry-in is not rejudged.
